subject: Deferred credit phasing for multi-region private offer & reseller margin routing
messages:
From: Ava Patel <ava.patel@cloudnova.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Rivers <ethan.rivers@finops.cloudnova.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: phased deferred credits + channel split for multi-region PO

Hi Jasmine / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — CloudNova is close to budget approval but procurement has two asks before we can sign: a) the deferred credit schedule needs phasing rather than a single-year giveback, and b) we need a clearer illustration of how reseller margin is routed across regions (US/EU) for private offers.

Specifically:
- Can we phase the $225k deferred credit over Q3 and Q4 (50/50) instead of applying it as an up-front contra?
- We need a worked example that shows list price -> private-offer discount -> reseller uplift (net to Redwood), and how taxes/withholding are handled for EU-bound invoices.

I've attached a draft PO and a simple channel model. Procurement would like an ops-friendly PDF they can pass to finance. If you can reply with a brief matrix (timing / invoices impacted / who issues credits) that would help.

Ava
Ava Patel
Director, Strategic Procurement — CloudNova
ava.patel@cloudnova.com

Attachments: CloudNova_PrivateOffer_Draft_PO.pdf, channel-split-model.xlsx
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Patel <ava.patel@cloudnova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: phased deferred credits + channel split for multi-region PO

Thanks Ava — looping in Ben and Tessa to align on the finance/ops side. Quick notes from our side below, we'll follow up with a short matrix and an invoice example by EOD tomorrow.

High level answers:
- Phased deferred credit: OK to do 50/50 over Q3/Q4. We'll represent it as two credit memos tied to the private-offer invoice series so bookkeeping is straightforward.
- Channel margin routing: We'll provide two worked rows in the model: (1) US customer invoiced in USD -> reseller commission paid via partner payout (post-invoice); (2) EU customer invoiced from our EU entity with VAT handling; net to Redwood after reseller uplift will be documented.

Open items for CloudNova to confirm:
- Do you want the credits applied to the initial onboarding invoice or to the recurring monthly usage invoices? (Applying to onboarding makes the cap table cleaner; applying across recurring invoices smooths cash flow for you.)
- Any special tax withholding rules for your EU reseller we should know about?

We'll attach the matrix + a one-page example showing the timing, responsible issuer (Redwood vs reseller), and the accounting effective date.

-Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: phased deferred credits + channel split for multi-region PO

Jasmine/Ben — thanks for the quick acknowledgement. Two clarifications from our accounting team:

1) For our auditors, it would be best if the deferred credits are issued as credit memos tied to explicit invoice IDs rather than as an off-ledger adjustment.
2) For EU transactions: our reseller is registered in Ireland and will be invoiced net of VAT; we need to ensure Redwood's documentation shows the VAT flow (reverse charge vs VAT-registered recharge) so our tax team can sign off.

If you can provide the invoice-example + credit memo template and an annotated channel waterfall (one-row US, one-row EU) that captures list price -> Redwood PO discount -> reseller uplift -> net, we can route to auditors and procurement.

Regards,
Ethan Rivers
FinOps Manager — CloudNova
ethan.rivers@finops.cloudnova.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Patel <ava.patel@cloudnova.com>, Ethan Rivers <ethan.rivers@finops.cloudnova.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: phased deferred credits + channel split for multi-region PO

Hi Ava / Ethan — attaching the one-page matrix and the two worked examples you asked for. Summary below:

- Credit phasing: We will issue two credit memos tied to the onboarding invoice IDs: 2027-1001 (50%) dated 2027-09-01, 2027-1002 (50%) dated 2027-11-01. Credit memos will reduce AR on Redwood's books and will be visible to CloudNova for reconciliation.
- Invoice flow (US): Redwood issues invoice to CloudNova (USD). Reseller commission is paid to the partner as a separate payout; Redwood reports gross revenue and then records reseller payout as partner expense.
- Invoice flow (EU): Redwood's EU entity issues invoice net of VAT handling per reverse-charge; reseller uplift is handled via partner payout in EUR and we will include a VAT annotation in the invoice PDF.

Files attached: CloudNova_PrivateOffer_Draft_PO.pdf (annotated), channel-split-model.xlsx (two-sheet: US / EU waterfall).

Next steps: If this looks good, please confirm and we will issue a redlined PO and the first credit memo schedule for signatures.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Marketplace & Channel Economics | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: CloudNova_PrivateOffer_Draft_PO.pdf, channel-split-model.xlsx
